post.description:
Force a recompute of cached match scores.

Runs Stage 1 (embedding) and the deterministic Stage 2 re-rank synchronously
so explanations are available immediately, then enqueues an async LLM re-rank
(worker) that upgrades the explanations in place. The shared rate-limiter caps
how often this AI-heavy path can be hit.
Capture thumbs up/down feedback on a match ("good" | "poor").

post.description:
Read-only conversational agent over the user's own saved data.

The model decides which tools to call; every tool is executed with the
authenticated user's ID injected server-side, so retrieval can never cross
user boundaries. No write actions in v3 scope.

get.description:
Serve a stored object by key, scoped to the current user's ownership.

Only keys under known namespaces are servable; anything else is rejected so
a user can never address another user's (or arbitrary) files.
